highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
The International School of Management (ISM) is one of the leading private business schools in Germany, and is home to over 3,800 students. It is the only AACSB-accredited private German university of applied sciences.

ISM is also ranked as one of the best private German universities by CHE. It also collaborates with industry partners, offering students practical experience and exposure.

highlights.title: Student Life
highlights.value:
ISM has 7 campuses with students from over 84 nationalities and around 190 partner universities. The University has a faculty-student ratio of 1:7 and offers a personalised learning environment.

ISM provides outstanding support services, including a student counselling facility and a career centre. The University organises tours, parties, and other events throughout the year.

You can join one of the many student clubs at ISM to better enjoy your study period. You also have fantastic transportation links from all the campuses to the city centres.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value: The ISM does not offer accommodation. However, you can ask your student advisor for tips on finding affordable options.
